purpose: Remove individually identical nested turn-packet policy keys from the serialized primary narration request, and measure that reduction without a provider call.
executive_summary: Verdict A/PASS. Live provider calls: 0. omit_duplicate_turn_packet_policy now drops each nested policy key whose complete JSON value equals the root, and keeps differing and root-absent keys. The root policy hash is unchanged. On the F3 build_messages reconstruction the blob falls from 83,040 bytes to 80,403, a reduction of 2,637 bytes (3.18%). The admission estimate falls from 27,744 to 26,865, minus 879. That estimate is bytes divided by 3 plus 64. It matches the AT-OPT-03 hypothesis and is not a provider bill. The recorded F3 input remains 22,777. Twelve equal keys are removed. response_delta, answer_completeness, and planner_seam_trace stay, and their value hashes are unchanged. No other request section hash changes. must_advance_scene stays true. New matrix 17/17 and existing provider-efficiency tests 7/7. Adjacent authority and publication tests 118/118. Frozen developer holdout 28/28, redirected so the historical results file was not rewritten. Protected files 150/150. The same three KeyError failures were present before the edit. Provider-free checks do not prove that a model reads the shorter request as the same narration.
